releases.name: OpenKodo Code 0.1.3 — macOS, Windows, Linux (unsigned beta)
releases.body:
**What's new**

- **No Orca left in the product.** The updater, Star and issue links, deep links (`openkodo://`), menus, window titles, dialogs, notices, config filenames, data directory, environment variables, macOS bundle identity and helper apps all belong to OpenKodo now.
- **The CLI is `openkodo` everywhere.** The bundled launcher, helper binaries, generated help, recovery commands and agent instructions use the same command on macOS, Windows and Linux.
- **Orca Cloud sign-in is gone.** The cloud endpoints, profile sign-in surfaces and console entry are removed; this build is a local-first client for your OpenKodo subscription.
- **Our own plugin marketplace.** Official catalog owner, publisher and reserved names are OpenKodo; bundled themes ship under `openkodo.*`; plugin manifests are `openkodo-plugin.json` (existing `orca-plugin.json` still loads).
- **Docs, skills and locales rewritten** for the new command name, including every bundled skill guide and the docs site.

**Install (unsigned beta).** macOS: open the DMG, drag OpenKodo to Applications, then right-click → Open the first time (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/OpenKodo.app`). Windows: run the installer; SmartScreen may ask for confirmation. Linux: unpack the tarball.

releases.name: OpenKodo Code 0.1.2 — macOS, Windows, Linux (unsigned beta)
releases.body:
**What's new**

- **One-click sign-in.** In the console, *API keys → Open in OpenKodo Code* launches the app already signed in. Starting from the app instead (Settings → Accounts → OpenKodo → Continue in browser) signs you in on the web and returns to the app authenticated. Codes are single-use and expire in two minutes.
- **English by default.** New installs start in English; System and every other language stay in Settings.
- **First-run fixes** carried over from 0.1.1 (device-code login, OpenCode provider written automatically, usage meters).

**Install (unsigned beta).** macOS: open the DMG, drag OpenKodo to Applications, then right-click → Open the first time (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/OpenKodo.app`). Windows: run the installer; SmartScreen may ask for confirmation. Linux: unpack the tarball.

releases.name: OpenKodo Code 0.1.1 — macOS, Windows, Linux (unsigned beta)
releases.body:
Second beta. All three desktop builds come from CI (macOS built with the same commit) and are attached here.

Fixed since 0.1.0
- The auto-updater now points at OpenKodo/openkodo instead of the upstream Orca releases. 0.1.0 could have replaced itself with Orca; do not use it.
- The window title is OpenKodo.

Works
- Settings → Accounts → OpenKodo: device-code sign-in, key stored in the OS keychain, OpenCode provider written automatically for the models your plan can use.
- 5h / 7d / monthly meters from the OpenKodo usage API.

Unsigned beta: macOS needs right-click → Open (or xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine), Windows SmartScreen will warn.
